title: Saddling Timelike Liouville Theory
summary: The two-sphere partition function of timelike Liouville theory admits two complementary semi-classical descriptions whose relation presents a non-perturbative puzzle. A direct path-integral expansion around the round two-sphere saddle reproduces the perturbative small-$β$ expansion, with $β$ the Liouville coupling, of the analytically continued Dorn-Otto-Zamolodchikov-Zamolodchikov (DOZZ) formula, while the latter contains an additional oscillatory factor suggestive of a second saddle contribution.
